AVID Core/README.md:88:Callbacks run on the operation's worker thread and must return promptly without panicking. They can forward events to a host channel. Automatic hardware failure starts another Encoding stage and progress may restart. Only `Stage::Complete` means publication succeeded; an FFmpeg fraction of 1 does not mean the file is published. No host should assume cancellation after Complete can undo the output.
